product_name: Bajaj Life Group Critical Illness (CI) Rider
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Group Health Rider (to be attached to a group base Policy)
key_benefits: Rider Sum Assured payable on first diagnosis of a covered Critical Illness during the policy tenure
Cover options for 17 or 32 Critical Illnesses, available as either Accelerated CI Benefit or Additional CI Benefit
Rider premium rates guaranteed throughout the membership term of the member
Member can include the rider from inception or any Annual Renewal Date, and opt out at any Annual Renewal Date

eligibility.policy_term: Aligned to the group base policy / membership term
eligibility.note: Member entry-age and sum-assured boundaries not stated numerically in this sales literature. Maximum cover ceasing age per rider terms. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: Same as the base product, applicable from the Date of Commencement of Rider if different from the base policy's Date of Commencement of Risk.
key_terms.grace_period: As per the base policy. On occurrence of Critical Illness during the grace period, the CI Benefit is payable subject to deduction of due-but-unpaid rider premium.
key_terms.waiting_period: 90 days from start of coverage (CI diagnosed within the Waiting Period is excluded; not applicable on consecutive renewal of CI cover for the member).
key_terms.survival_period: 30 days — no benefit if the insured dies within 30 days of diagnosis of the covered Critical Illness.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: No maturity benefit under the rider.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws'. GST charged additionally over and above premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Detailed CI definitions, conditions and exclusions (17 & 32 CI lists)

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a RIDER, not a standalone policy — every claim must reference that it attaches to and depends on a group base policy.

Each listed Critical Illness pays only if the strict policy definition and severity criteria are met (e.g. specified histological/imaging/severity thresholds); illnesses are not covered in plain-language form.
Benefit is payable only on FIRST diagnosis, only after the 90-day Waiting Period, and only if the member survives the 30-day Survival Period.
Number of conditions covered must be stated accurately as the chosen option (17 or 32 CIs).
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market as a standalone health/insurance plan — it cannot be sold without a group base policy.
Do NOT imply maturity, savings, surrender or loan value — there is no maturity benefit and no surrender value on exclusion of the rider.
Do NOT state 'all cancers / all heart attacks' covered — many sub-conditions (e.g. carcinoma in situ, early-stage cancers, angina, TIA) are explicitly excluded.
Do NOT omit Waiting Period (90 days), Survival Period (30 days), pre-existing-disease and other standard exclusions when describing the benefit.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Group Health Rider' attaching to a group base policy
That the rider must be read with the base policy; CI definitions, Waiting Period, Survival Period and exclusions apply
Standard disclaimer to read the sales brochure and policy document before concluding a sale
